description: Bootstrap affix.js v3.2.0 source code implementing affix behavior for UI elements, including class definition, methods, and plugin setup.

classes.name: Affix
classes.description: Class managing the affix behavior, including position checking and class toggling based on scroll position.

methods.name: getPinnedOffset
methods.description: Calculates and caches the offset at which the element becomes pinned.

methods.name: checkPositionWithEventLoop
methods.description: Schedules a position check after a short delay.

methods.name: checkPosition
methods.description: Determines whether the element should be affixed to top, bottom, or unpinned based on scroll position.
